INTAKE
Patient: PAT-053
Board coordinator asks for the external biomarker result to be added to tomorrow's packet. The accompanying PDF is labelled with case code LUN-24-18.
files./workspace/tumorboard/pathology.txt:
PATHOLOGY INDEX
Patient: PAT-053
Resection accession: LUN-24-81. Tissue block: B4. The report header lists a right upper-lobe specimen and a collection date of 18 June.
files./workspace/tumorboard/vendor_report.txt:
VENDOR REPORT
Case code: LUN-24-18
Specimen: lung tissue, block B4. A target alteration is reported. The second page contains only the submitting institution name; no patient identifier appears in the exported copy.
files./workspace/tumorboard/correspondence.txt:
CORRESPONDENCE
A laboratory portal message from 09:12 says a report was released after an amended accession request. The message references LUN-24-81 but does not attach the amendment or name a specimen block.
